status: bounded source and read-only Gemian resource audit; cycle not admitted
source_findings: Selected gen3 WLAN HIF maps AP-DMA offset 0x80 for 0x80 bytes; DT names the shared INFRA_AP_DMA clock wifi-dma.

Selected MT6797 DT lists I2C DMA channel windows from offset 0x100 (i2c0) through 0x5ff, UART DMA windows beginning at 0x600, and BTIF windows at 0xa00; these compared named windows do not coincide with WLAN offset 0x80. The I2C driver uses the DT's second resource in the selected OF branch.
The same INFRA_AP_DMA clock is referenced by WLAN, I2C, UART and BTIF; per-channel addresses do not confer exclusive clock ownership.

With CONFIG_MTK_CLKMGR disabled, WLAN devm_clk_get(wifi-dma) logs IS_ERR but continues; HifPdmaInit also marks DMA enabled after an unchecked ioremap. Clock-enable failures are logged without propagating a status.

The dynamic 2 MiB CONSYS reservation feeds WLAN's first 512 KiB and WMT's separate 343 KiB mapping beginning at +512 KiB; WMT can write remap/protection state and clear its mapped part during native initialization. Separate payload offsets do not establish exclusive remap or lifetime ownership.
limits: The single live Gemian clock snapshot reports counts but cannot attribute the prepared reference to a consumer, establish concurrent DMA traffic or validate the compile-only candidate or a radio cycle.
The source comparison covers named selected consumers, not every possible physical alias, firmware master or direct register writer.
No hardware access to AP-DMA, EMI, clocks or radio was performed in this audit.
